title: Difference Between Element Sum and Digit Sum of an Array
statement: Every value in `nums` is a positive integer. Compute two totals: the **element sum**, which adds up the values themselves, and the **digit sum**, which adds up every individual decimal digit written in those values (repeated digits each count). Return `|elementSum - digitSum|`, the absolute difference of the two totals.
notes:
## Intuition

Both totals come from the same numbers, so one pass can build them side by side. The element sum is a plain running total. For the digit sum, the last decimal digit of a number is its remainder modulo 10, and dividing by 10 (rounding down) drops that digit, so repeating the two steps peels off every digit.

A number's digits never add up to more than the number itself (equality only for single digits), so the difference is never negative; the absolute value simply follows the definition.

## Approach

1. Start `elementSum` and `digitSum` at `0`.
2. For each `num`, add it to `elementSum`.
3. Copy it into `rest`. While `rest > 0`, add `rest % 10` to `digitSum` and set `rest` to `Math.floor(rest / 10)`.
4. Return `Math.abs(elementSum - digitSum)`.

## Example 1, step by step

`nums = [1, 15, 6, 3]`.

- `1`: `elementSum = 1`, digit `1` gives `digitSum = 1`.
- `15`: `elementSum = 16`; `rest = 15` adds `5`, then `rest = 1` adds `1`, so `digitSum = 7`.
- `6`: `elementSum = 22`, `digitSum = 13`.
- `3`: `elementSum = 25`, `digitSum = 16`.

The answer is `|25 - 16| = 9`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(n · d), where d is the number of digits (at most 4 here), so effectively O(n).
- Space: O(1): two totals and one working copy.

## Pitfalls

- In JavaScript `/` is real division; without `Math.floor` the digit loop keeps going on fractions and adds garbage.
- Work on a copy (`rest`) so the original `num` is still available for the element sum.
- Repeated digits count every time they appear: `11` contributes `2` to the digit sum, not `1`.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `elementSum` | total of the values in `nums` |
| `digitSum` | total of every digit of every value |
| `num` | the current value |
| `rest` | the part of `num` whose digits are not yet added |

narration.2: Running total of the values themselves.
narration.3: Running total of every digit seen.
narration.6: Add the whole number to the element sum.
narration.7: Copy the number so its digits can be peeled off.
narration.9: The last digit is the remainder after dividing by 10.
narration.10: Drop that last digit by integer division.
narration.14: Return the absolute difference of the two totals.
